final: WITH profile_avgs AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), with_mean AS (SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) OVER () AS mean_profile_avg FROM profile_avgs) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, avg_bandusagepct - mean_profile_avg AS difference_from_mean FROM with_mean WHERE mean_profile_avg IS NOT NULL
